note: P1, P2 and P3 repeat one design: a collapsed bar that expands to a vertical five-stage timeline of a single parcel, dark neutral palette, and only the placement (top-right vs bottom-right) and footer differ; P4 is the only real departure, a multi-package list. Q varies more: Q1 is a package-management panel with an add form, Q2 a per-package timeline list, Q3 stacked package cards in a pill, and Q4 a segmented All/Active/Delivered panel with a horizontal dot stepper and mint accent, though Q1 and Q2 share a bottom-right pill-and-list pattern.
